title: Transport of the finite Kummer boundary comparison
statement:
theorem finiteP1_kummer_chern_realization_of_boundary
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (cX : Chern l E X)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (n : ℕ)
    [Finite (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)]
    {hX : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(X, ⊤))}
    (c : SpTowerP1.CoefficientCoordinates l E n X hX)
    (t : (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E X n).obj ((line l E cX)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
      (finiteOverRealization l E n e).obj
        (geoP1Twist (FiniteRing l E n) (l ^ (n + 1))
          (ULift.ext _ _ (coefficient_annihilates l E n)) (ProjectiveLine S) 1 2))
    (ht : t = finiteP1KummerCoordinate l E n e cX hS c)
    (hb : FiniteP1BoundaryData l E e cX n) :
    (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E X n).map
        (firstChern l E cX
          (Scheme.Pic.mapHom e.hom (hyperplanePic S))) ≫ t.hom =
      (finiteOverUnitCoordinate l E n e c).hom ≫
        (finiteOverRealization l E n e).map
          ((geoP1Comparison (FiniteRing l E n) (ProjectiveLine S)).map
            (geoP1EtaleChern (FiniteRing l E n) (l ^ (n + 1))
              (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _)
              (ULift.ext _ _ (coefficient_annihilates l E n)) S
              (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hS.pow (n + 1))))

proof.text: For the normalized canonical comparison, both evaluated tower c1 (by hb) and the ordinary finite Kummer arrow (by the ordinary boundary lemma) have the same integral boundary after forgetting coefficients. The finite integral-generator detection theorem therefore makes these two coefficient arrows equal.

Expand evaluatedChern through its single and shift comparisons [lem-sfb-finite-p1-kummer-evaluated]. Precompose the equality by the source single isomorphism and postcompose by the finite line coordinate. Cancel inverse isomorphisms. The source coordinate is finiteOverUnitCoordinate [lem-sfb-finite-p1-kummer-unit-equation], and ht identifies the target coordinate with t.

Require t to be the explicit normalized comparison. The only caller needs existence and now constructs this comparison directly.
